title: WAPC approval of lots with average site area up to 5% below Table 4B
text: M4.1.2 The WAPC, in consultation with the local government, may approve the creation of a green title lot, survey-strata lot or strata lot with an average site area up to 5 per cent less than that specified in Table 4B where it will: i. facilitate the protection of an environmental or heritage feature; ii. facilitate the retention of a significant element that contributes toward an existing streetscape worthy of retention; iii. facilitate the development of lots with separate and sufficient frontage to more than one public street; iv. overcome a special or unusual limitation on the development of the land imposed by its size, shape or other feature; v. allow land to be developed with housing of the same type and form as land in the vicinity and which would not otherwise be able to be developed; or vi. achieve specific objectives of the local planning framework.
notes: from: ch3 M4.1.2. diverges: average site area only (no minimum), strata lots included, no battleaxe exclusion and no 'not more than one lot' limb; six grounds as current P1.1.2. WAPC discretion, not an applicant test.
